title: calophaca tianschanica
intro: Calophaca tianschanica, commonly known as the Tianshan calophaca or Chinese calophaca, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Calophaca tianschanica include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative properties.
